title: Visited positions under return-state simulation
statement: Let $M$ be a machine with $m$ work tapes, and embed those tape indices into $k$ work tapes. For any initial contents and head positions on the $k$ tapes, output prefix, $m$-tape configuration $c$, time $t$, and $k$-tape index $j$, the set of positions visited by tape head $j$ through time $t$ in the simulation with a distinguished return state, started from the embedded configuration with states renamed into the left summand, equals the corresponding set for the simulation without the return state started from the embedded configuration.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices
A machine $M$, initial tape contents and head positions, an output prefix, and an $m$-tape configuration $c$
